text:
Sam H: quick ask — can we borrow 4 x A100 preemptible in us-west2 for a 3h small burst tonight? terraform apply is queued, need IAM for the svc-account to attach GPUs. project tag = project:redwood-loadtest. any invoice/billing gotchas? @Nicole (Infra)
Nicole (Infra): tagging / cost center question — who owns the chargeback for this burst? cc @Jordan (Finance)
Jordan (Finance): if you set billing_project:redwood-poc we can catch it, otherwise it lands on shared dev. prefer explicit cost_center tag. estimated spend?
Sam H: rough est = ~$600-$900 depending on preemptible churn. adding cost_center in the tf var now.
Sam H: terraform snippet i'm about to run:
```
module "burst_cluster" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/gke-burst.git//modules/gpu-cluster"
  project = "redwood-poc"
  node_count = 4
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
  preemptible = true
  service_account = "svc-gpu-burst@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```
Nicole (Infra): thanks. two bits: 1) need iam roles: compute.instanceAdmin.v1 + serviceAccountUser on that svc-account for the terraform runner, 2) confirm quota first — sending to gcp-quota-bot.
gcp-quota-bot: Current quotas for project redwood-poc in us-west2: GPU_A100_40GB: quota=8, used=5, available=3. Preemptible reservations not tracked separately. ETA for quota increase: 48-72h (request pending).
Oncall Ops: preemptible churn last week spiked evictions at ~25% after midnight in us-west2 — if this is user-facing demo might be flaky. fallback plan: either reduce to 2 nodes or fallback to regional non-preemptible slice.
Sam H: thanks — it's a load test, not customer-facing. can we get a 1-off exception or borrow from demo pool? @Maya (Platform) any internal demo pool to dip into?
Maya (Platform): we have 2 spare A100s in the demo pool til 02:00 PT, but they'd be preemptible too. I can hold them if you confirm start window. Otherwise Finance needs cost_center tag to approve moving more.
Jordan (Finance): hold pattern OK, but need billing_project + cost_center tag in PR. once present i'll approve a charge transfer.
vendor-gcp-sales: if you need guaranteed capacity for a few hours we can provision preemptible+short-term reserved mix; ping me and I can expedite a quote (may take 1-2h).
Sam H: plan: use 2 demo-pool A100s + 2 preemptible from quota (since quota available=3). I'll update tf with billing_project:redwood-poc and cost_center:loadtests and run at 23:30 PT. tagging PR in ~10m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
